blindSpots: Headed browser and machine FPS are unverified in this host. Do not read wall time as a frame rate.
Real iPhone hardware is not tested. simulated-touch is a separate surface.
Chromium lab parity remains focused flight only (src/testing/lab/KNOWN_GAPS.md G3).
Renderer, audio, and VFX stay detached. A missing GPU capture is not a missing-model defect.
Open PRs own hot gameplay files. This manifest does not patch them.

driven.reel: reelDelta via KeyQ / KeyE line length

journeys.cue: Leave the cradle under your own thrust.
journeys.title: Launch

journeys.cue: Put the massline on the rock, then cut it.
journeys.title: Tether attach and cut

journeys.cue: The line is already on the heavy rock. Reel and pull.
journeys.title: Heavy-object handling

journeys.cue: Hold the mining beam on the rock in front of you.
journeys.title: Mining

journeys.cue: Approach the station corridor. Do not claim a berth you have not reached.
journeys.title: Docking

journeys.cue: You are at the Helios counter. Buy silicate, then fit a cargo scanner.
journeys.title: Buy and refit

journeys.cue: Take the board offer. Finish it if the objective is already met, otherwise abandon it.
journeys.title: Mission accept, complete, or fail

journeys.cue: Fight the wasp. If you are wrecked, request recovery.
journeys.title: Combat, death, retry

journeys.cue: Begin a survival run and press through loadout and intros.
journeys.title: Crucible wave progression

journeys.cue: Request the Ceres gate, then save and continue.
journeys.title: Save and continue after sector travel

personas.summary: Gentle thrust, rare hesitation, no weapons, tether only when the cue is the line.
Full throttle, boost, wide seeded turns, fires when something is close.
Slow approach, no boost, reel when lined, buys and fits only at a berth.
Flies the cue, accepts the visible offer, abandons when the contract will not finish.
Holds the line, strafes, and reels in a seeded orbit attempt.
Burst input then long gaps, as if frames and edges were dropped. Touch runs quantize further.
Flies, requests a gate jump, then saves and continues from that envelope.
Contradictory axes, repeated buys, missing mission ids, scan spam, dock probe while far.

surfaces.note: Quantized stick. Not a physical phone.
